title: Information Theory for Machine Learning
description: Connect entropy, cross-entropy, divergence, and mutual information to learning objectives.
learningOutcomes: Interpret information measures mathematically and operationally
Use divergence and mutual information carefully

lessons.title: Surprise, Entropy, and Coding
lessons.description: Measure uncertainty as expected information and connect it to compression.

lessons.title: Cross-entropy and Maximum Likelihood
lessons.description: Derive the loss used by classifiers and language models.

lessons.title: KL Divergence and Distribution Distance
lessons.description: Measure asymmetric mismatch without mistaking divergence for a metric.

lessons.title: Mutual Information and Representation Learning
lessons.description: Measure dependence and reason about informative representations.
